description: This Java class implements the PermissionReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve permission data from a database, including all permissions, maker-checkerable permissions, and role-specific permissions. It uses Spring's JdbcTemplate for database operations and Lombok annotations for boilerplate reduction.
external_methods: JdbcTemplate.query(String sql, RowMapper<T> rowMapper, Object... args)

classes.name: PermissionReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of permission reading service providing permission data retrieval methods.

classes.name: PermissionUsageDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps SQL ResultSet rows to PermissionData objects, with methods to generate specific SQL queries for different permission schemas.

methods.name: retrieveAllPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves all non-checker permissions from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllMakerCheckerablePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions that are maker-checkerable, excluding special, read, and checker permissions.

methods.name: retrieveAllRolePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a specific role ID.
